class.name: AdapterHelper
class.brief_description: Queues and applies incremental update operations.
class.description: AdapterHelper is an internal port of [i]RecyclerView.AdapterHelper[/i]: it queues the [code]notify_item_*[/code] operations, sorts / merges them, and applies them to the cached ViewHolders' positions at the end of the frame. You normally do not touch it; use the [b]RecyclerView[/b] notify methods instead.

method.name: apply_pending_updates_to_position
method.description: Applies all queued operations to a given position.

method.name: apply_updates_to_holder
method.description: Applies queued operations to a holder's stored position.

method.name: has_pending_updates
method.description: Returns whether any update is still queued.
